objective: Increase likely Geometry & construction fidelity and period/authenticity by replacing the generated apartment balcony's bracket-only separation cue with a physically reasoned framed mineral-board separation assembly, while preserving evidence integrity and avoiding any unrendered Visual Fidelity claim.

discovery.gap: Each HD_BayAssembly already contained front low/high divider brackets and fasteners, but no corresponding separation board/frame. The visible support cue therefore lacked the manufactured component it was intended to support.
discovery.priorityReason: A repeated missing balcony construction element affects all 30 bays and is more likely to cap Geometry & construction fidelity / scene authenticity than another narrow QA-only contract.

manufactureReasoning.board: 6 mm calcium-silicate/fibre-cement-like dry dielectric board; exact historical manufacturer/model is not claimed.
manufactureReasoning.mounting: Existing front divider-bracket zone remains the front attachment context; two explicit rear wall brackets and four 12 mm fastener heads provide the facade-side load path.
manufactureReasoning.floorInterface: 60 mm clear gap above the generated slab-top datum.
manufactureReasoning.orientation: Vertical YZ partition at the left edge of every generated balcony bay.
manufactureReasoning.exposureAging: Dry midsummer UV/rain exposure with interface grime/chalking only; no arbitrary damage narrative.
manufactureReasoning.geometryVsMaterial: Board thickness, frame, brackets, fasteners and clearances are geometry. Fibre/mineral relief, fine chalking and roughness breakup are material response. Painted highlights/shadows are forbidden.

materialReasoning.physicalData: 1024 normal + metallic/smoothness; Uncompressed, Crunch off, linear, mipmapped, Repeat, Trilinear, anisotropy >=8, no Standalone override

implementation.ownership: Separate Danchi child root; DanchiHighDetail remains on its established six-material physical-UV registry.
implementation.sourceGeometry: Directly generated authored GM_BP_ chamfered/beveled Mesh assets; no Unity Cube/Cylinder source renderers are introduced.
implementation.physicalUv: UV0 stores metres plus deterministic 8x8 cut-origin phase; phase varies by assembly/part to reduce obvious repeated microtexture restart.

lod.lod3Retention: board core remains as the large occlusion/silhouette proxy

implementation.formalEvidenceGuard: Reflection, QA4K_, QATemporal_ and QAPreparedTemporal_ pre-cull validation is read-only/fail-closed; no geometry/material/import repair is permitted inside formal render callbacks.
implementation.metadataBinding: balcony_separation_panel_contract.json is linked into the Danchi domain contractPaths in scene_metadata_coverage_contract.json, so the construction/material evidence binder will include it with the scene evidence generation.

designCorrectionsDuringRun.issue: Initial implementation placed the new board material under DanchiHighDetail before the existing physical-UV pass.
designCorrectionsDuringRun.whyWrong: QualityBlockDetailPhysicalUvUpgrade intentionally permits exactly six canonical detail materials; a seventh board material would be rejected as unregistered and would weaken a mature source contract if silently added.
designCorrectionsDuringRun.correction: Moved the separation system into a dedicated Danchi child root, generated authored metre-UV meshes directly, gave each panel its own LODGroup, and moved construction after the DanchiHighDetail physical-UV pass. The six-material DanchiHighDetail contract remains unchanged.

designCorrectionsDuringRun.issue: Initial metadata described a 24 mm fastener head while the shared mesh-library convention interprets legacyScale.x/z as final diameter.
designCorrectionsDuringRun.correction: Aligned code and contract to a 12 mm head diameter with 16 mm axial depth.

designCorrectionsDuringRun.issue: Initial LOD policy allowed the whole partition to disappear at LOD3.
designCorrectionsDuringRun.correction: Retained the large board core at LOD3 so the major balcony occlusion/silhouette does not vanish before final cull; actual temporal pixels remain mandatory.
